main_description: Link your Discord account with your CAS auth account to access the Discord servers that are reserved for these users.
unlink_from_discord_notice: If you unlink your Discord account, it will propably lose its access to servers where the bot is setup. However, you will be able to re-link it again right after.
discord_not_linked: You have not linked your Discord account yet, press the button below :
discord_linked: Your Discord account is currently linked, you should have access to the Discord servers that are protected by this bot.
help_page_content: You will find here useful information to help you use the bot.
about_page_content: This bot is a project developed by students of the ULB. It aims to provide a secure way to link your Discord account with your CAS auth account.

privacy_policy_content:
Cookies

We only use stricly-necessary cookies required for using the website, such as maintaining your session when you log in. These cookies do not store any personal information and do not require your consent under GDPR. These cookies' rules are set as strict cross-site behavior, meaning that only this very website, and none of the possible subdomains, can use these cookies.

Personal data

The only information that is stored by this service is one that is necessary to link your Discord account with your CAS auth account. This includes: your Discord username, Discord user ID, your CAS user ID, CAS user email address and your CAS full name. This information is stored securely and is not shared with any third party. When you unlink your Discord account from the user page (after login), all the information that was stored is deleted.
